summary.headline: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 64.4% YoY to INR222.97 crore and EBITDA rose 88.8% to INR42.16 crore, with EBITDA margin at 18.9%.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations reached INR222.97 crore in Q2 FY27, up 64.4% YoY and 38.5% QoQ, with growth attributed mainly to volume rather than realisation. EBITDA of INR42.16 crore (18.9% margin, up 244 bps YoY) and PAT of INR28.06 crore (12.6% margin) both grew strongly. H1 FY27 revenue was INR383.97 crore (+61.9%), with operating cash flow of INR51.16 crore. Management reiterated the 5,500 MT freeze-dried coffee (FDC) project, now expected to start trial production in August 2027 and commercial production from September 2027, and discussed a possible small equity raise that is still subject to alternative funding.

financial_highlights.metric: Gross margin / EBITDA / EBITDA margin (H1 FY27)

financial_highlights.change: +52.3% YoY vs INR32.07 crore (ETR 9.3% in H1 FY26)

segments.name: Spray-dried and agglomerated coffee
segments.commentary: Installed capacity is 11,000 MT per annum after 4,500 MT was commissioned at end-March 2026; utilisation is about 95%. Product mix is about 55% agglomerated and 45% spray-dried, and management plans to shift further toward agglomerated.

segments.name: Chicory
segments.commentary: Capacity is fully utilised. Volume rose about 5% because of a crop shortage, and sales prices rose about 4-5%.

segments.name: Geography
segments.commentary: Exports are about 85% of revenue and domestic about 15% in Q2 FY27.

segments.name: Pack mix
segments.commentary: Small packs are about 55% and bulk about 45% of current revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 margins expected to stay in the same range with a marginal improvement; the FY27 spray-dried plus agglomerated volume visibility is about 10,500 MT.
FY28-FY29 growth guided at about 80-85%, with the total 16,500 MT plant expected to be fully utilised.
FDC margins expected to be 2-3% higher once Phase 1 runs; the second 5,500 MT phase adds a further 1-1.5%, for 3-4% in total at full utilisation of 22,000 MT.
Phase 1 FDC: trial production August 2027, commercial production from September 2027; about 70% utilisation in the second half of FY28 for 6-7 months of production.
Q1 and Q2 FY28 expected to show YoY growth of about 5-10%, with realisation benefit of 20-25% from higher agglomerated mix.
Cash flow from operations expected to stay positive for the full year.
FDC plant turnover expected at INR670-710 crore, with ROCE similar to the existing business.
capex_capacity: Installed capacity is 11,000 MT of spray-dried and agglomerated coffee. Total capacity rises to 16,500 MT when the 5,500 MT FDC Phase 1 comes on stream, and to 22,000 MT after Phase 2 (FY30).
FDC Phase 1 total capex is about INR550 crore, of which about INR220 crore is spent. About INR150 crore is planned for the rest of FY27 and the balance in H1 FY28.
Phase 2 (5,500 MT brownfield FDC) capex is about INR350 crore. The final decision and order are expected in Q1 FY28, with commercial operations from April 2029 and full capacity in FY30.
A separate agglomeration line and packing line (funded partly by promoter warrants, with a 25% contribution expected in 10-15 days) will add capacity within the 11,000 MT spray and agglo envelope.
Land of 22 acres was acquired at TGIIC Food Processing Park, Telangana, to cover the entire FDC facility.
Letters of intent covering 100% of Phase 1 capacity have been received from customers.
demand_pricing: Revenue growth was mainly volume-driven, not realisation-driven. Management described Q2 realisation as marginally higher than Q1 and expects Q3 to be stable with a slight improvement from pack mix.
Management expects Q3 and Q4 to be higher-sales quarters as they are the peak season for soluble coffee.
Volume growth of about 40% against value growth of about 60-65% was attributed to a higher coffee mix; the chicory share is included in volume.
Bean sourcing is 65-70% from India and 30-35% from Uganda and Indonesia. Management expects bean prices to stay flat to slightly lower.
Four to five new customers were added for spray and agglomerated coffee in H1 FY27.
Roasted and ground coffee: initial export orders for a couple of containers have been shipped; management expects a sizeable order if the first orders execute.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Q2 growth came from volume versus realisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the growth came from volume, not higher realisation per kg.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 11,000 MT plant at 95% utilisation, and how much FDC capex is done?
qa_highlights.answer: Spray and agglo utilisation is about 95%; FDC capex incurred is INR220 crore of INR550 crore, with the rest in the pipeline.

qa_highlights.question: Why is there an equity dilution if expansion was to be funded by debt and internal accruals?
qa_highlights.answer: European FCY loans are sanctioned, but a negative pledge clause makes Indian bank borrowing difficult, so a small dilution is being considered and alternative funding is being explored. The board has approved a fundraise of about INR325 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Will the B2C strategy change the B2B focus?
qa_highlights.answer: B2C via e-platforms continues for now; large-scale B2C is planned from FY30 after the second FDC line, with domestic and international options.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a delay in the FDC project?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the start moved from June-July 2027 to August-September 2027 because of ESG formalities linked to the European bank loan.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin uplift from FDC and the second phase?
qa_highlights.answer: FDC adds 2-3% to margins once Phase 1 runs, and Phase 2 adds 1-1.5%, giving 3-4% in total at 22,000 MT utilisation.

risks_watch: Funding: the equity dilution (board-approved, about INR325 crore) is not final and depends on alternative debt; the negative pledge clause limits Indian bank loans.
Execution: the FDC Phase 1 start moved by one to two months to August-September 2027; the Phase 2 decision is due Q1 FY28.
Logistics and geopolitics: export-heavy (85%) sales depend on international shipping, and rising ocean freight raised selling expenses. Other expenses rose from INR7 crore to INR14 crore QoQ.
Key-person and disclosure issues: the transcript lists the FDC completion and capex figures inconsistently (INR500 crore vs INR550 crore), and the FY28 volume and margin figures need confirmation.
Utilisation: spray and agglo is at about 95% against the 11,000 MT cap, so further growth depends on the new agglo line and capacity additions.
Comparability: H1 FY26 figures are not restated for the amalgamation of subsidiaries, which took effect from 1 October 2025.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on current operations and the FDC timeline, with a few clarifications and corrections during Q&A. Management was cautious and somewhat evasive on the equity dilution, saying it may not be needed and that alternative funding is being explored.
key_quotes: Q2 FY27 was another very strong quarter for the company with revenue from operations increasing by 64.4% year-on-year and 38.5% sequentially to INR222.97 crores compared to INR135.61 crores in Q2 FY26.

We are considering a slight dilution of equity, but this will be subject to whether we are able to arrange the required funding through other sources.

adds.what: 5,500 MT freeze-dried coffee (FDC) Phase 1 plant, Telangana (INR550 cr total capex, INR220 cr spent)
5,500 MT brownfield FDC Phase 2 (INR350 cr capex; decision expected Q1 FY28, commercial ops April 2029)
Agglomeration line and packing line within 11,000 MT spray/agglo envelope (partly funded by promoter warrants)

growth.why: Management guides ~80-85% growth for FY28-FY29 backed by the 5,500 MT FDC Phase 1 (INR550 cr, trial Aug 2027, commercial Sep 2027, letters of intent for 100% of capacity) and 95% utilisation of the 11,000 MT spray/agglo base, but the FDC start has slipped and Phase 2 funding is uncertain given negative pledge clauses.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: FY27 margin guided at same range with marginal improvement; FDC adds 2-3% to margins once Phase 1 runs (Sep 2027), and Phase 2 adds 1-1.5% more, for 3-4% total at 22,000 MT; Q2 EBITDA margin was 18.9%, up 244 bps YoY, though gross margin fell 133 bps QoQ and other expenses doubled QoQ to INR14 crore.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: 5,500 MT FDC Phase 1 (INR550 cr, INR220 cr spent) has trial production in August 2027 and commercial production from September 2027, a one-to-two month slip, with letters of intent covering 100% of Phase 1 capacity; the separate agglo and packing line adds capacity within the 11,000 MT envelope.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management guides Q1 and Q2 FY28 YoY growth of about 5-10% and FY28-FY29 growth of about 80-85%, backed by 95% utilisation of the 11,000 MT spray/agglo base, 10,500 MT FY27 visibility, and four to five new customers added in H1 FY27.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Phase 2 (5,500 MT FDC, INR350 cr) final decision and order are expected in Q1 FY28 with utilisation at 95%, though the funding route (equity of about INR325 cr, board-approved, not final) is uncertain.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 margins are guided at the same range with only marginal improvement, and the FDC start has already slipped by one to two months, so there is no clear case for a raise.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: FDC start moved from June-July to August-September 2027 due to ESG formalities on the European bank loan, the equity raise is unresolved, and export freight costs are rising (other expenses INR7 cr to INR14 cr QoQ).

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Roasted and ground coffee has initial export orders for a couple of containers shipped and management expects a sizeable order if they execute, but no launch date or volume was given.

rows.label: Equity raise of about INR325 cr (board-approved) vs alternative debt
rows.why: The board approved a fundraise of about INR325 cr, but management said it may not be needed and a negative pledge clause limits Indian bank borrowing, so funding mix is unresolved.

rows.label: Realisation uplift from agglomerated mix shift
rows.why: Management expects a 20-25% realisation benefit from a higher agglomerated mix (currently ~55% agglo), while Q3 FY27 realisation is guided stable with a slight pack-mix improvement.

rows.label: FDC Phase 1 letters of intent
rows.why: Letters of intent cover 100% of the 5,500 MT Phase 1 capacity, which supports the FDC plant turnover of INR670-710 cr expected once it runs.

tone.note: Management was confident on current operations (95% utilisation, 80-85% FY28-29 growth guide) and the FDC timeline, but cautious and somewhat evasive on the equity dilution and funding; analysts pushed on volume versus realisation, the FDC delay, and why equity was needed.
